Specification: This module specifies a single-variable system used to sample a random subset of the function set [S -> T], where S is a finite set of nine integers and T is the integer range 1..10. The comments explain that the full function space has 10^8 elements and should not be explicitly enumerated, so the design instead initializes x to an element of RandomSubset(1000, [ S -> T ]). The behavior after initialization is pure stuttering, and the specification includes a trivial invariant Inv == TRUE rather than a substantive safety or liveness property.
